subheader: Setup, migration, training — the figures that do not recur
lead: Each row names the service, states the fee and explains what the fee covers. The third column is the one that stops a figure from being argued about later.
note: The note carries what applies to every line — tax, when it is invoiced, surcharges for out-of-hours work.

fees.title: The service is the row header
fees.text: So a fee read on its own still knows what it is a fee for.

fees.title: The fee keeps its own column
fees.text: Tabular figures, so the amounts line up down the table.

fees.title: What it covers is prose
fees.text: A sentence, not a keyword — this is the column that answers questions before they are asked.

fees.title: A fee may be zero
fees.text: Stating a zero is worth more than leaving the row out.
